_comment: Named device states an app test can ask for. Each scenario is a list of VT control primitives (TemperatureSensor docs/vt-control.md) run in order, then `expect` is checked against the board's status object. {param} placeholders come from the scenario action's params.

happy.description: Normal operation: readings flow (dummy 19.0/20.1 C in test builds), HTTP, setup, Wi-Fi and MQTT all work.

sensor-fail.description: The sensor is broken: readings are ok:false with err={err}.

http-error.description: The board's HTTP endpoints answer status {status}.

http-hang.description: The board accepts HTTP connections but never answers (app request timeouts).

setup-reject.description: POST /setup (provisioning) fails with 500 and stores nothing.

offline.description: The board leaves the home network and stays off it (soft-AP unchanged).

mqtt-silent.description: The board stops publishing readings over MQTT; HTTP still works.

unprovisioned.description: Forget the app-provisioned Wi-Fi credentials and reboot, like a fresh board.
